package.name: agentic_nav
package.description: Agentic navigation layer for the G1: a robot-agnostic skill/interface stack on top of the existing geometric A*+MPC planner. Phase 1 exposes the low-level navigation through a clean NavigationInterface + skills so it can be driven and TESTED end-to-end before any VLM/agent is added. The spatial memory and language/VLM skills are scaffolded but deferred.
